## Task and changes

- Task ID and brief
- User-facing change
- Branch commit and preview URL

## Automated checks

| Check | Result and evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Plan links | |
| Lint and typecheck | |
| Unit tests | |
| Production build | |

## Browser evidence

- Desktop and mobile-width screenshots or short clip
- User A and User B outcomes
- Outsider access check
- Refresh, duplicate submission, and early departure if applicable
- Pending checks or known issues

## Reviewer notes

- What to open and exactly what to try
- Migration and environment impact
- Confirm the PR preview points to a development database

Zia owns final review and merge.
